source: externally pinned, validated categorical phase model; fixed learned state maps and raw decoder
selection: minimum original-record mean ordinary raw CE; improvement greater than 1e-10; bank-order ties
selection_inputs: original training records only, with distinct IDs and retained repeated inputs
features: normalized positive-phase full discrete Fourier code on source latent states
coefficients: complete conjugate decoder initializer, all real and imaginary coefficients stored and charged
prediction: cached actual full complex products, recomputed and checked when loading; no answer formula
head_radius: 64 times the source latent-state count, per-class sum of absolute real and imaginary coefficients
source_spectral_budget: retained separately; latent-moment bounds do not replace the complete output-head budget
gradients: ordinary CE on original record positions, complete real and imaginary derivatives, each tail uses its own denominator
training: confidence initialization only; zero added optimizer updates and zero added gradient batches in every mode; inherited source training metadata explicit
scope: no new raw-label identification, pooled task metrics must be measured afresh, no held-out confidence guarantee
